home.title: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
home.intro: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common hormonal disorder that occurs during reproductive years. Women with PCOS may have irregular menstrual cycles, increased androgen levels, and changes in ovarian structure.
home.description: In PCOS, many small fluid-filled sacs may develop along the outer edge of the ovaries. These sacs are called follicles and contain immature eggs. The follicles may fail to release eggs regularly. The exact cause of PCOS is unknown; however, early diagnosis, lifestyle modification, physical activity, and weight management may reduce long-term complications such as type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease.
